sharedRules.name: Flame-thrower
sharedRules.description:
Infantry, Gun, and Unarmoured Tank Teams re-roll successful Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower and the Unit is automatically Pinned Down. Armoured Tank Teams use their Top armour for Armour Saves when hit by a Flame-thrower.

Flame-throwers may shoot in Defensive Fire. However, while a Unit that is Hit by a Flame-thrower is Pinned Down, this does not automatically stop the assault. The defender still needs to score five (or eight) hits as normal to stop the assault as normal.

sharedRules.name: Crafty
sharedRules.description: Crafty Tanks have better Tactics ratings.

sharedRules.name: Flammable
sharedRules.description: Flammable Tanks have worse Motivation and Assault ratings.

sharedRules.name: Heavy Tank
sharedRules.description: Heavy Tanks have a better Counterattack rating.

sharedRules.name: Not One Step back
sharedRules.description: Units with Not One Step Backhave a better Last Stand rating.

sharedRules.name: For the Motherland
sharedRules.description: Infantry with For the Motherland have a better Assault rating.

sharedRules.name: Komissar
sharedRules.description: While their Komissar team is In Command, a Unit has a better Motivation, as shown in the Komissar column (marked *Soviet symbol*) on the Unit Card.

sharedRules.name: Redemption
sharedRules.description:
When a Penal Company is placed on the table during Deployment (but not if it is placed outside the normal Deployment Area using the Spearhand rule), the player may immediatley Move its Teams at Tactical or Dash speed.

This movement may not use any Movement Orders, and may not take a Team within:
- 16"/40cm of an enemy Team it is not Concealed from,
- 8"/20cm of any enemy Team,
- 16"/40cm of the enemy Deployment Area or any Objective outside your own Deployment Area.

A Penal Company may not be placed in Reserve.
A Penal Company never benefits from Bulletproof Cover.
A Penal COmpany can prevent the enemy from Holding an Objective, but cannot Hold an Objective. Ignore a Destroyed Penal Company when calculating Victory Points.

sharedRules.name: Unit Transport
sharedRules.description: The Unit Leader of the Transport Attachment must end the Movement Step within 6"/15cm of the Unit Leader of its Passenger Unit while on the Table. If it cannot do this, then the Transport Attachment must be Sent to the Rear (see page 45 of the rulebook).

sharedRules.name: Urrah
sharedRules.description: Units with Urrach may move 6"/15cm (instead of 4"/10cm) when Charging into Contact.

sharedRules.name: Sapper Body Armour
sharedRules.description: A Team with Sapper Body Armour rolls a die when hit in Assault combat. On a roll of 6 they are unharmed, on any other roll they are destroyed as usual.

sharedRules.name: Pioneers
sharedRules.description: Pioneer Teams cross Minefields safely on a roll of 2+. If they remain in the Minefield and are not Pinned Down, they may clear the Minefield automatically in their next turn.

sharedRules.name: Assault Smoke
sharedRules.description: Engineer-Sapper Teams that fire smoke Bombardment may Move and Assault in the same turn they fire a Smoke Pots Smoke Bombardment.

sharedRules.name: Limited 2
sharedRules.description:
Each time this Unit shoots, # number of its Teams may shoot as that Weapon rather than its usual weapons.

Each time this Unit rolls to Hit in an Assault, # number of its Teams may attack with that Weapon rather than its usual weapons.

sharedRules.name: Salvo
sharedRules.description:
Weapons with a ROF of "salvo" are Artillery weapons and fire Artillery Bombardments, but use a 10”/25cm square Salvo Template rather than the normal 6”/15cm Artillery Template.

A Salvo Template may not be placed within 6"/15cm of a friendly Team.

sharedRules.name: Flying Tank
sharedRules.description: Flying Tanks have a worse Is Hit On rating, but a better Save.
